subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When an unfinished draft branch is pushed, only final-draft-readiness shall be deferred; all other applicable source checks, including memory integrity, shall run. When preparation, prepared-head publication, or lock is requested, the system shall require full memory integrity and current-digest draft readiness and refuse every unmet condition. The temporary problem A-4 exception is not a production gate policy.
rationale: Open scaffolds and rounds are intentionally unready.
fit_criterion: Normal opening/round push succeeds with the readiness-only deferral and all other checks green; final prepared head and lock pass the complete memory-integrity gate, including lossless problem/delivery bindings, plus current-digest reviews and every readiness condition; invalid evidence or missing bindings refuse without publication.
